entries.title: Psalms 92:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm [or] Song for the sabbath day.>> [It is a] good [thing] to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

entries.title: Psalms 92:2
segments: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night, {every...: Heb. in the nights}

entries.title: Psalms 92:3
segments: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound. {the harp...: or, the solemn sound with the harp} {a solemn...: Heb. Higgaion}

words.text: Upon an instrument of ten strings
. {the harp...: or, the solemn sound with the harp} {a solemn...: Heb. Higgaion}

entries.title: Psalms 92:4
segments: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

entries.title: Psalms 92:5
segments: O LORD, how great are thy works! [and] thy thoughts are very deep.

entries.title: Psalms 92:6
segments: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

entries.title: Psalms 92:7
segments: ¶When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; [it is] that they shall be destroyed for ever:

words.text: ; [it is] that they shall be destroyed

entries.title: Psalms 92:8
segments: But thou, LORD, [art most] high for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 92:9
segments: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

entries.title: Psalms 92:10
segments: But my horn shalt thou exalt like [the horn of] an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

entries.title: Psalms 92:11
segments: Mine eye also shall see [my desire] on mine enemies, [and] mine ears shall hear [my desire] of the wicked that rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 92:12
segments: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 92:13
segments: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 92:14
segments: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing; {flourishing: Heb. green}

words.text: They shall still bring forth fruit

entries.title: Psalms 92:15
segments: To shew that the LORD [is] upright: [he is] my rock, and [there is] no unrighteousness in him.
